title: gitglimpse belongs on your radar
description:
dino-zecevic/gitglimpse is the kind of repo that can quietly upgrade a developer workflow. A CLI that extracts structured context from your git history — for AI agents, PR descriptions, and standups. It has about 28 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.
